{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = data_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(3)

# Print full response rate by site
print("Response rate by site:")
print(response_rate_by_site)

# Get the site with the highest response rate
best_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
best_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

print(f"The site with the highest response rate is {best_site} with a rate of {best_rate}")"}
